# KafkaDiskAlmostFull

<!-- GENERATED by monitoring/dashgen from internal/rules (make alerts). Do not edit. -->

| Severity | Component | Dashboard | for (production / demo) |
|---|---|---|---|
| critical | kafka | [kafka-pods](http://grafana.localhost:8080/d/kafka-pods/) | 5m / 1m |

**Summary:** Kafka volume <persistentvolumeclaim> has less than 10 % free space

Broker <kafka_broker> (<pod>) is about to run out of disk. When the log dir is full the broker marks it offline and its partitions become unavailable on this replica.

## Impact

The broker is minutes to hours away from taking its log dir offline.

## Diagnosis

1. Same as KafkaDiskFillingUp; also check for compacted topics that never compact (log cleaner, uncleanable partitions).

## Mitigation

- Act now: lower retention on the biggest topics, delete unused topics, expand the volume.

## Expression

```promql
(kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes / kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes < 0.1) * on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left (kafka_cluster, kafka_broker, pod) (max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, pod) (kube_pod_spec_volumes_persistentvolumeclaims_info) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (kafka_cluster, kafka_broker) (max by (namespace, pod, kafka_cluster, kafka_broker) (kafka_server_kafkaserver_brokerstate) * 0 + 1))
```
